title: It takes a village – or a Phoenix suburb – to wrangle a wayward tortoise
summary: When a large tortoise named Rex got loose, a Phoenix-area neighborhood went into a tizzy. More than just a fun commotion, Rex's daring getaway shows the challenges of sulcata tortoise ownership.
